user.title: Home Checkup
user.description:
Checks your home once a day and tells you, in plain words, what needs a look. It only reads. It never changes or removes anything by itself.

It works with Home Assistant's own Repairs: it adds at most one note there, lists only log errors that keep coming back, never counts what Home Assistant already shows, and never changes Home Assistant's own repairs.

It is built with your privacy in mind. Everything stays in your home: nothing is sent to any server. It never opens secrets.yaml or the files where Home Assistant keeps passwords, keys and sign-ins. Passwords, keys, tokens and email addresses in log messages are hidden before they are shown.
